summary: KB Financial Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary Kookmin Bank declared an interim cash dividend of KRW 3,460 per common share, totaling approximately KRW 1.4 trillion. The record date is July 2, 2026, with payment expected on July 22, 2026. The entire dividend goes to the parent, KB Financial Group. This is a routine capital return event; the board resolved under Korean Commercial Code Article 53. No tender, acquisition, or restructuring. What to watch: whether KB Financial Group passes dividends to its own shareholders.
